"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - 3
    if budget <= 0:
        return "..."[:limit]
    head = text[: budget + 1]
    # Cut at the last whitespace that fits within the budget (word boundary).
    cut = None
    for i in range(len(head) - 1, -1, -1):
        if head[i].isspace():
            cut = i
            break
    if cut is None:
        # No full word fits; fall back to a hard cut.
        return text[:budget] + "..."
    return text[:cut].rstrip() + "..."
EOF

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
